en.s: The Battle of Lake Trasimene was fought when a Carthaginian force under Hannibal ambushed a Roman army commanded by Gaius Flaminius on 21 June 217 BC, during the Second Punic War. The battle took place on the north shore of Lake Trasimene, to the south of Cortona, and resulted in a heavy defeat for the Romans. War had broken out between Rome and Carthage early in 218 BC.

zh.s: 公元前217年6月21日，汉尼拔率领的迦太基军队伏击了盖乌斯·弗拉米尼乌斯指挥的罗马军队，爆发特拉西梅诺湖战役。这是第二次布匿战争中的一场战斗，发生在特拉西梅诺湖北岸、科尔托纳以南，罗马军队遭到惨败。罗马与迦太基于公元前218年初开战。

en.s: The Battle of Guadiaro (21 June 1010) was a battle of the Fitna of al-Andalus, that took place at the Guadiaro River near Ronda, between the Berber forces of Sulayman ibn al-Hakam with the help of Berber leaders such as Zawi ibn Ziri and other Zenata chiefs, against the combined forces of the Caliphate of cordoba led by the caliph Muhammad II of Córdoba numbered at 30,000 fighter and 9000 Catalan mercenaries.

zh.s: 瓜迪亚罗战役于1010年6月21日爆发，是安达卢斯内战的一场战斗，地点在龙达附近的瓜迪亚罗河。交战双方是苏莱曼·伊本·哈卡姆的柏柏尔军队（得到扎维·伊本·齐里等柏柏尔领袖和其他泽纳塔首领协助），以及由科尔多瓦哈里发穆罕默德二世率领的联军；后者有3万名战士和9000名加泰罗尼亚雇佣兵。

en.s: The Battle of Axspoele (sometimes Axpoele or Thielt) took place on 21 June 1128 on the landed estate of the lords of Axpoele in the County of Flanders between William Clito and Thierry of Alsace. The two men were rivals for the title of Count of Flanders. William had been appointed to the title by Louis VI of France following the 1127 murder of Charles the Good but Thierry, cousin of Charles, had the support of Henry I of England.

zh.s: 阿克斯波勒战役于1128年6月21日在佛兰德伯国阿克斯波勒领主的庄园内爆发。交战双方是威廉·克利托和阿尔萨斯的蒂埃里，两人都争夺佛兰德伯爵头衔。绰号“好人查理”的查理一世于1127年遭谋杀后，法国国王路易六世任命威廉为伯爵；查理的堂弟蒂埃里则得到英格兰国王亨利一世支持。

en.s: The Battle of Laupen was fought on June 21, 1339 between Bern and its allies on one side, and Freiburg together with feudal landholders from the County of Burgundy and Habsburg territories on the other. Bern was victorious, consolidating its position in the region. As a consequence of the conflict, the relations of Bern and the Swiss Confederacy tightened, resulting in Bern's permanent accession in 1353. This is also the first battle that the white cross was documented as being used as a field sign worn by Swiss combatants.

zh.s: 劳彭战役于1339年6月21日爆发，交战双方是伯尔尼及其盟友，以及弗里堡与勃艮第伯国和哈布斯堡领地的封建领主。伯尔尼获胜，巩固了其在当地的地位。此后，伯尔尼与瑞士邦联的关系进一步密切，伯尔尼于1353年正式加入邦联。这也是有记录以来瑞士战士首次将白十字作为战场标识佩戴。

en.s: The Battle of Hamadan or Alma Bulaghı in 1503 was a conflict between the Safavid Empire, led by Shah Ismail I and the Aq Qoyunlu, commanded by Güzel Ahmad. The battle occurred near the city of Hamadan in Western Persia. Shah Ismail's forces, consisting primarily of Qizilbash warriors, effectively employed superior tactics and firearms to defeat the Aq Qoyunlu cavalry.

zh.s: 哈马丹战役又称Alma Bulaghı战役。1503年，萨法维帝国与阿克科云鲁王朝在波斯西部哈马丹附近交战。萨法维军由沙阿·伊斯玛仪一世率领，阿克科云鲁军由居泽尔·艾哈迈德指挥。萨法维军以奇兹尔巴什战士为主，凭借更出色的战术和火器击败了阿克科云鲁骑兵。

en.s: The Battle of Landriano took place on 21 June 1529, between the French army under Francis de Bourbon, Comte de St. Pol and the Imperial–Spanish army commanded by Don Antonio de Leyva, Duke of Terranova in the context of the War of the League of Cognac. The French army was destroyed and marked the end of the ambitions of Francis I of France to vie for control of northern Italy with Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor.

zh.s: 兰德里亚诺战役于1529年6月21日爆发，交战双方是圣波尔伯爵弗朗西斯·德·波旁率领的法军，以及泰拉诺瓦公爵安东尼奥·德·莱瓦指挥的帝国与西班牙联军，战役属于科涅克同盟战争。法军全军覆没，法国国王弗朗索瓦一世与神圣罗马皇帝查理五世争夺意大利北部控制权的企图也就此终结。

en.s: The Battle of Besançon (21 June 1575) was a sectarian conflict between the Protestants and Catholics in the French city of Besançon in the region of Franche-Comté. Prior to the battle, the Huguenots, accused of heresy, had been expelled from the city and fled to the County of Montbéliard and Switzerland; the outcasts formed an army and planned an attempt to retake Besançon and turn the city into a stronghold of the Protestant Reformation. By the time the armed Protestants had reached the city of Besançon however, their army had dwindled because of several mishaps.

zh.s: 贝桑松战役于1575年6月21日在法国弗朗什-孔泰地区的贝桑松爆发，是新教徒与天主教徒之间的宗教冲突。战前，被指控为异端的胡格诺派教徒遭驱逐，逃往蒙贝利亚尔伯国和瑞士；这些流亡者组成军队，计划夺回贝桑松，并将该城变为宗教改革的据点。不过，武装新教徒抵达贝桑松时，因途中发生多次意外，队伍已经大幅减员。

en.s: The Honnō-ji Incident (本能寺の変, Honnō-ji no Hen) was the attempted assassination of Japanese daimyo Oda Nobunaga at Honnō-ji in Kyoto in 1582. Nobunaga was on the verge of unifying the country, but died by seppuku in the unexpected rebellion of his vassal Akechi Mitsuhide. Nobunaga only had a few guards and retainers with him when he was attacked, ending his Sengoku period campaign to unify Japan under his power.

zh.s: 本能寺之变（本能寺の変）是1582年发生在京都本能寺的一次叛乱，明智光秀试图刺杀日本大名织田信长。信长当时即将统一日本，却在家臣明智光秀意外发动的叛乱中切腹身亡。遇袭时信长身边只有少数护卫和随从，此事也终结了他在战国时代统一日本的征战。

en.s: Old Town Square execution (Czech: Staroměstská exekuce) was the execution of 27 Bohemian leaders (three noblemen, seven knights and 17 burghers) of the Bohemian Revolt by the Austrian House of Habsburg that took place on 21 June 1621 at the Old Town Square in Prague.

zh.s: 老城广场处决事件（捷克语：Staroměstská exekuce）发生于1621年6月21日，奥地利哈布斯堡王朝在布拉格老城广场处决了27名波希米亚起义领导人，其中包括3名贵族、7名骑士和17名市民。

en.s: The Battle of Kallo was a major field battle fought from 20 to 21 June 1638 in and around the forts of Kallo and Verrebroek, located on the left bank of the Scheldt river, near Antwerp, during the second phase of the Eighty Years' War. Following the symbolic recovery of Breda during the 1637 campaign, the Dutch Republic agreed with the French Crown, with whom it had allied in 1635, to besiege a major city in the Spanish Netherlands during the 1638 campaign.

zh.s: 卡洛战役是八十年战争第二阶段的一场重要陆战，于1638年6月20日至21日在安特卫普附近斯海尔德河左岸的卡洛和费尔布鲁克堡垒周边爆发。荷兰共和国于1637年象征性地收复布雷达后，与1635年结盟的法国王室商定在1638年战役中围攻西属尼德兰的一座重要城市。

en.s: The Battle of Scarrifholis was fought in County Donegal in the north-west of Ireland on 21 June 1650, during the Irish Confederate Wars – part of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms (Irish: Cogadh na dTrí Ríocht). It was fought between the Ulster Army (Catholic), commanded by Heber MacMahon, Roman Catholic Bishop of Clogher, and an English Parliamentarian army commanded by Charles Coote, 1st Earl of Mountrath and composed of troops from the New Model Army and local Ulster Protestant settlers. The battle resulted in the annihilation of the Ulster army and the loss of most of its weapons and supplies.

zh.s: 斯卡里弗霍利斯战役于1650年6月21日在爱尔兰西北部多尼戈尔郡爆发，属于爱尔兰邦联战争，也是三王国战争（爱尔兰语：Cogadh na dTrí Ríocht）的一部分。交战双方是天主教徒、克洛赫尔主教赫伯·麦克马洪指挥的阿尔斯特军，以及蒙特拉斯伯爵查尔斯·库特指挥的英国议会军。议会军由新模范军和当地阿尔斯特新教定居者组成。阿尔斯特军全军覆没，还损失了大部分武器和补给。

en.s: The Battle of Bloody Creek was a military engagement which was fought on 10/21 June 1711 during Queen Anne's War. A Wabanaki Confederacy force of 50–150 warriors successfully ambushed 70 provincial troops of the British New England Colonies at a place that became known as Bloody Creek after the battles fought there. The creek empties into the Annapolis River at modern-day Carleton Corner, Nova Scotia, and was also the location of a battle in 1757.

zh.s: 血腥溪战役于1711年6月10日（旧历）/6月21日（新历）爆发，属于安妮女王战争。沃巴纳基联盟派出50至150名战士，在后来被称为“血腥溪”的地点伏击了70名来自英属新英格兰殖民地的地方部队士兵。小溪在今新斯科舍省卡尔顿角附近汇入安纳波利斯河；1757年这里也发生过一场战斗。

en.s: Halifax, officially the Halifax Regional Municipality (HRM), is the capital and most populous municipality of the Canadian province of Nova Scotia, and the most populous municipality in Atlantic Canada. It consists of four former municipalities that were amalgamated in 1996: Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, and Halifax County. Halifax is an economic centre of Atlantic Canada, home to a concentration of government offices and private companies.

zh.s: 哈利法克斯（正式名称为哈利法克斯地区市镇）是加拿大新斯科舍省首府，也是加拿大大西洋地区人口最多的市镇。1996年，旧哈利法克斯、达特茅斯、贝德福德和哈利法克斯县合并组成今日市镇。哈利法克斯也是加拿大大西洋地区的经济中心，聚集了大量政府机关和私营企业。

en.s: The Constitution of the United States is the supreme law of the United States of America. It superseded the Articles of Confederation, the nation's first constitution, on March 4, 1789. Originally including seven articles, the Constitution defined the foundational structure of the federal government. The drafting of the Constitution by many of the nation's Founding Fathers, often referred to as its framing, was completed at the Constitutional Convention, which assembled at Independence Hall in Philadelphia between May 25 and September 17, 1787.
en.n: New Hampshire becomes the ninth state to ratify the Constitution of the United States.

zh.t: 新罕布什尔州批准《美国宪法》
zh.s: 《美国宪法》是美利坚合众国的最高法律。1789年3月4日，它取代了美国第一部宪法《邦联条例》。宪法最初由七条组成，规定了联邦政府的基本架构。许多美国开国元勋在费城独立厅举行的制宪会议上起草宪法，会议于1787年5月25日至9月17日召开。
zh.n: 新罕布什尔州成为第九个批准《美国宪法》的州。

en.s: (This article is about an engagement during the Irish Rebellion of 1798. For the 1804 battle in Australia, see Castle Hill convict rebellion.) The Battle of Vinegar Hill (Irish: Cath Chnoc Fhíodh na gCaor), was an engagement during the Irish Rebellion of 1798 on 21 June 1798 when over 15,000 British soldiers launched an attack on Vinegar Hill outside Enniscorthy, County Wexford, the largest camp and headquarters of the Wexford United Irish rebels. It marked a turning point in the rebellion, as it was the last attempt by the rebels to hold and defend ground against the British military.

zh.s: 醋山战役（爱尔兰语：Cath Chnoc Fhíodh na gCaor）发生于1798年6月21日，是1798年爱尔兰起义中的一场战斗。超过1.5万名英军向韦克斯福德郡恩尼斯科西附近的醋山发起进攻；那里是韦克斯福德联合爱尔兰人叛军最大的营地和总部。这场战斗成为起义的转折点，也是叛军最后一次尝试守住阵地、抵抗英军。

en.s: The Irish Rebellion of 1798 (Irish: Éirí Amach 1798; Ulster Scots: "The Turn Out"/"The Hurries") was a popular insurrection against the British Crown in what was then the separate, but subordinate, Kingdom of Ireland. The main organising force was the Society of United Irishmen. First formed in Belfast by Presbyterians opposed to the landed Anglican establishment, the Society, despairing of reform, sought to secure a republic through a revolutionary union with the country's Catholic majority.
en.n: Irish Rebellion of 1798: The British Army defeats Irish rebels at the Battle of Vinegar Hill.

zh.s: 1798年爱尔兰起义（爱尔兰语：Éirí Amach 1798；阿尔斯特苏格兰语称“The Turn Out”或“The Hurries”）是当时独立但受英国王室管辖的爱尔兰王国发生的一场民众起义。主要组织力量是联合爱尔兰人协会。该协会最初由贝尔法斯特反对土地所有者和圣公会精英统治的长老会信徒建立；在改革无望后，协会转而寻求通过革命，与爱尔兰的天主教多数群体联合建立共和国。
zh.n: 1798年爱尔兰起义：英军在醋山战役中击败爱尔兰叛军。

en.s: Battle of Tabkin Kwatto (lit. 'Battle of Lake Kwatto') was the first decisive battle in the Fulani War. Abdullahi Ibn Fodio and Umaru al Kammu engaged the numerically superior Gobir cavalry at Kwatto Lake near the Capital fort of Gobir; Alkalawa. The Fulani archers employed a square formation which they successfully defended against successive charges by the Gobir cavalry.

zh.s: 塔布金夸托战役（字面意思为“夸托湖之战”）是富拉尼战争中第一场具有决定性意义的战役。阿卜杜拉希·伊本·福迪奥和奥马鲁·卡姆武在夸托湖附近与人数占优的戈比尔骑兵交战；夸托湖靠近戈比尔首府阿尔卡拉瓦的城堡。富拉尼弓箭手采用方阵，成功抵挡了戈比尔骑兵一轮又一轮的冲锋。

en.s: The first siege of Girona during the Peninsular War, also called the battle of Gerona, took place from 20 to 21 June 1808, when an Imperial French division led by Guillaume Philibert Duhesme try to overrun a Spanish garrison commanded by Lieutenant Colonels O'Donovan and O'Daly. The French assault failed and the attackers withdrew.

zh.s: 半岛战争期间的赫罗纳第一次围城战也称赫罗纳战役，于1808年6月20日至21日爆发。纪尧姆·菲利贝尔·迪埃姆率领的法兰西帝国军师试图攻占由奥多诺万和奥达利两名中校指挥的西班牙守军，但法军进攻失败，随后撤退。

en.s: At the Battle of Vitoria (21 June 1813) a British, Portuguese and Spanish army under General the Marquess of Wellington broke the French army under Joseph Bonaparte and Marshal Jean-Baptiste Jourdan near Vitoria in Spain, eventually leading to victory in the Peninsular War.

zh.s: 维多利亚战役于1813年6月21日爆发。威灵顿侯爵率领的英、葡、西联军在西班牙维多利亚附近击溃由约瑟夫·波拿巴和让-巴蒂斯特·儒尔当元帅指挥的法军，最终促成半岛战争胜利。

en.s: The Ottoman–Egyptian invasion of Mani was a campaign during the Greek War of Independence that consisted of three battles. The Maniots fought against a combined Egyptian and Ottoman army under the command of Ibrahim Pasha of Egypt. On March 17, 1821, the Maniots (residents of the central peninsula on the southern part of the Peloponnese) declared war on the Ottoman Empire, preceding the rest of Greece in joining the revolution by about a week.

en.s: The Raid on Short Hills (June 21–23, 1838) was an incursion and attack by the Hunter Patriots on the Niagara Peninsula during the Upper Canada Rebellion. On June 11, 1838, Irish American James Morreau led a rebel raiding party of 26 Hunter Patriots across the Niagara River into Upper Canada. Morreau was aided by Samuel Chandler, a wagon maker from the village of St Johns in Thorold Township, Upper Canada.

zh.s: 肖特希尔斯突袭（1838年6月21日至23日）是猎人爱国者在上加拿大叛乱期间对尼亚加拉半岛发动的入侵和袭击。1838年6月11日，爱尔兰裔美国人詹姆斯·莫罗率领26名猎人爱国者叛军越过尼亚加拉河，进入上加拿大。莫罗得到塞缪尔·钱德勒的协助；钱德勒是上加拿大索罗尔镇区圣约翰村的一名马车制造商。

en.s: The Battle of Alsónyárasd, took place between 20 and 21 June 1849, in Alsónyárasd, as part of the Battle of Pered of the Summer Campaign of the Hungarian War of Independence. During the first day of the Battle of Pered the Csallóköz region played a secondary role, representing the marching ground and supply route of the Hungarian troops.

zh.s: 奥尔索尼亚拉什战役于1849年6月20日至21日在奥尔索尼亚拉什爆发，是匈牙利独立战争夏季战役中佩雷德战役的一部分。佩雷德战役第一天，恰洛科兹地区处于次要地位，主要是匈牙利军队的行军和补给路线。

en.s: The Battle of Pered, fought on 20–21 June 1849, was one of the battles which took place in the Summer Campaign of the Hungarian War of Independence from 1848 to 1849, fought between the Hungarian Revolutionary Army and the Habsburg Empire helped by Russian troops. The Hungarian army was led by General Artúr Görgei, while the imperial army was led by Lieutenant field marshal Julius Jacob von Haynau.

zh.s: 佩雷德战役于1849年6月20日至21日爆发，是1848至1849年匈牙利独立战争夏季战役中的一场战斗。交战双方是匈牙利革命军，以及得到俄军支援的哈布斯堡帝国军。匈牙利军由阿尔图尔·格尔盖指挥，帝国军由陆军中将尤利乌斯·雅各布·冯·海瑙指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Simmon's Bluff was a minor and bloodless Union victory, fought June 21, 1862, in Meggett, South Carolina, during the American Civil War. Union forces had laid siege to Charleston, which was being resupplied from a nearby railroad. Union forces were eager to capture the city, so they sent the 55th Pennsylvania Infantry regiment to sever the rail line. The 55th Pennsylvania departed by sea shortly before the battle in search of a place to land closer to the railroad. On June 21, the 55th Pennsylvania came ashore at Wadmelaw Sound.

zh.s: 西蒙斯布拉夫战斗于1862年6月21日在南卡罗来纳州梅格特发生，是美国内战期间联邦军一次规模不大、没有伤亡的胜利。联邦军当时围困查尔斯顿，而附近铁路为该城运送补给。联邦军希望夺取该城，于是派宾夕法尼亚州第55步兵团切断铁路。战前，该团乘船出发，寻找更靠近铁路的登陆地点；6月21日，他们在瓦德梅劳湾上岸。

en.s: The Battle of Upperville took place in Loudoun County, Virginia on June 21, 1863 during the Gettysburg Campaign of the American Civil War.

zh.s: 上维尔战役于1863年6月21日在弗吉尼亚州劳登县爆发，属于美国内战期间与葛底斯堡战役相关的军事行动。

en.s: The Battle of LaFourche Crossing (also spelled Lafourche Crossing) took place at Lafourche Crossing, Louisiana, on June 20–21, 1863, during the American Civil War. In order to support the besieged garrisons of Port Hudson, Louisiana, and Vicksburg, Mississippi, Confederate forces in the Trans-Mississippi Department went on the offensive.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拉福什克罗斯战役也拼作Lafourche Crossing，于1863年6月20日至21日在美国路易斯安那州拉福什克罗斯爆发，属于美国内战。为支援遭围困的路易斯安那州哈德逊港和密西西比州维克斯堡，邦联军跨密西西比部在该地区发起进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Jerusalem Plank Road, also known as the First Battle of the Weldon Railroad, was fought June 21–23, 1864, near Petersburg, Virginia. It was the first of a series of battles during the Siege of Petersburg aimed at extending the Union siege lines to the west and cutting the rail lines supplying Petersburg. Two infantry corps of the Union Army of the Potomac attempted to sever the railroad, but were attacked and driven off by the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia's Third Corps, principally the division of Brig. Gen. William Mahone.

zh.s: 耶路撒冷木板路战役也称威尔登铁路第一次战役，于1864年6月21日至23日在弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡附近爆发。这是彼得斯堡围城战期间一系列战斗的第一场，联邦军意图向西延伸包围线，并切断为彼得斯堡提供补给的铁路。波托马克联邦军的两个步兵军试图切断铁路，却遭北弗吉尼亚邦联军第三军反击并被击退；邦联军主要由威廉·马洪准将的师作战。

en.s: The Tauranga campaign was a six-month-long armed conflict in New Zealand's Bay of Plenty in early 1864, and part of the New Zealand Wars that were fought over issues of land ownership and sovereignty. The campaign was a sequel to the invasion of Waikato, which aimed to crush the Māori King (Kingitanga) Movement that was viewed by the colonial government as a challenge to the supremacy of the British monarchy.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 陶朗加战役是1864年初在新西兰丰盛湾地区持续约六个月的一场武装冲突，也是新西兰战争的一部分。新西兰战争围绕土地所有权和主权问题展开。陶朗加战役发生在怀卡托入侵之后；后者旨在镇压毛利王运动，殖民政府认为该运动挑战了英国君主的统治。

en.s: The siege of Mexico City was an 1867 military engagement in the Second French intervention in Mexico between Republican forces, aided by the United States, and Emperor Maximilian's troops, aided by the French Empire and Austria-Hungary, encompassing in the siege of the city. It was the last armed conflict of the Second Mexican Empire and the fall of the city resulted in the transition of the Empire into the Republic led by Benito Juárez.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 墨西哥城围城战是1867年墨西哥第二帝国期间的一场军事行动。共和军在美国协助下，与马克西米连皇帝的部队交战；后者得到法兰西帝国和奥匈帝国支持。围城战是墨西哥第二帝国最后一场武装冲突。墨西哥城陷落后，帝国被推翻，贝尼托·华雷斯领导的共和国建立。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Wairau by-election 1875 was a by-election held in the Wairau electorate in the Marlborough Province during the 5th New Zealand Parliament, on 21 June 1875. The by-election was caused by the resignation of incumbent MP Arthur Seymour and was won by Joseph Ward, who defeated William Sefton Moorhouse. Ward was a well-known politician in Marlborough.

zh.s: 1875年怀劳选区补选于1875年6月21日举行，是新西兰第五届议会期间在马尔堡省怀劳选区进行的补选。现任议员亚瑟·西摩辞职后触发补选，约瑟夫·沃德击败威廉·塞夫顿·穆尔豪斯胜出。沃德是马尔堡当地知名政治人物。

en.t: The United States captured Guam from Spain in a bloodless event during the Spanish–American War
en.s: The capture of Guam from Spain by the United States took place in a bloodless engagement during the Spanish–American War. The U.S. Navy sent a single cruiser, USS Charleston, and three vessels of marines to capture the island of Guam, which was a Spanish possession. The Spanish garrison on the island had no knowledge of the war and no real ability to resist the American forces.

zh.t: 美西战争期间，美国未遇抵抗便从西班牙手中夺取关岛
zh.s: 美西战争期间，美国从西班牙手中夺取关岛，过程中没有发生流血冲突。美国海军派出一艘巡洋舰“查尔斯顿”号和三艘载有海军陆战队员的船只前往关岛。西班牙驻军既不知道战争已经爆发，也没有能力抵抗美军。

en.s: The Boxer Rebellion, also known as the Boxer Uprising, Boxer Movement, Yihetuan Movement (traditional Chinese: 義和團運動; simplified Chinese: 义和团运动), or Boxer War, was an uprising in North China between 1899 and 1901, towards the end of the Qing dynasty, by the Society of Righteous and Harmonious Fists. Its members were known as the "Boxers" in English, owing to many of them practicing Chinese martial arts, which at the time were referred to as "Chinese boxing".
en.n: Boxer Rebellion: China formally declares war on the United States, Britain, Germany, France and Japan, as an edict issued from the Empress Dowager Cixi.

zh.s: 义和团运动又称拳乱、义和团起义或义和团战争，是清朝末年1899年至1901年间发生在中国北方的一场起义，由义和团领导。其成员在英语中被称为“拳民”，因为许多人练习当时被称为“中国拳术”的武术。
zh.n: 义和团运动：清政府颁布慈禧太后的懿旨，正式向美国、英国、德国、法国和日本宣战。

en.s: The 1907 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 20th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1907 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Fraher Field, Dungarvan, on 21 June 1908, between Kilkenny, represented by a club side from Mooncoin, and Cork, represented by a club side from Dungourney.

zh.t: 1907年全爱尔兰高级板棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1907年全爱尔兰高级板棍球锦标赛决赛是第20届全爱尔兰决赛，也是1907年这项郡际赛事的收官战，由爱尔兰各郡的顶级球队参加。比赛于1908年6月21日在邓加文的弗雷赫球场举行，基尔肯尼郡由穆恩科因俱乐部代表，科克郡由邓古尼俱乐部代表。

en.s: Guinn v. United States, 238 U.S. 347 (1915), was a United States Supreme Court decision that found certain grandfather clause exemptions to literacy tests for voting rights to be unconstitutional. Though these grandfather clauses were superficially race-neutral, they were designed to protect the voting rights of illiterate white voters while disenfranchising black voters.
en.n: This entry records the decision, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 《奎恩诉美国案》（238 U.S. 347，1915年）是美国最高法院的一项裁决。法院认定，某些为识字测试设置的“祖父条款”豁免违宪；这些条款表面上不分种族，实际却旨在保障不识字白人的投票权，同时剥夺黑人选民的选举权。

en.s: The Battle of Carrizal occurred on the June 21, 1916. It was a major skirmish between United States Army troops of General John J. Pershing's Punitive Expedition and Carrancista troops fought at the town of Carrizal in the Mexican state of Chihuahua.

zh.s: 卡里萨尔战役于1916年6月21日爆发，是美国潘兴将军领导的惩罚性远征军与卡兰萨派部队之间的一场重要交火，战斗发生在墨西哥奇瓦瓦州卡里萨尔镇。

en.s: The Raid on Erbeyli was a raid conducted by the Kuva-yi Milliye. After invading Aydın and Nazilli, the Greek army was concerned about resistance movements raising in the area. The raid against the Malgaç bridge a few days ago was a good example for their feeling of unease.

en.t: Scuttling of the German fleet at Scapa Flow
en.s: On 21 June 1919, shortly after the end of the First World War, the Imperial German Navy's High Seas Fleet was scuttled by its sailors while held off the harbour of the British Royal Navy base at Scapa Flow, in the Orkney Islands of Scotland. The fleet was interned there under the terms of the Armistice of 11 November 1918 while negotiations took place over its fate.

zh.t: 德国公海舰队在斯卡帕湾自沉
zh.s: 1919年6月21日，第一次世界大战结束不久，德国帝国海军公海舰队的水兵将舰队自行凿沉。当时舰队依照1918年11月11日停战协定被扣留在苏格兰奥克尼群岛斯卡帕湾英国皇家海军基地外海，等待各方谈判决定其处置方式。

en.t: The Irish village of Knockcroghery is burned by British forces
en.s: Knockcroghery (Irish: Cnoc an Chrochaire) is a village and townland in County Roscommon, Ireland. It is located on the N61 road between Athlone and Roscommon town, near Lough Ree on the River Shannon. The townland of Knockcroghery is in the civil parish of Killinvoy and the historical barony of Athlone North. Knockcroghery developed as a largely linear settlement close to Galey Castle, a 14th-century tower house overlooking Galey Bay.

zh.t: 爱尔兰诺克克罗格里村遭焚毁
zh.s: 1921年6月21日凌晨，爱尔兰独立战争期间，英国“黑棕部队”放火烧毁罗斯康芒郡的诺克克罗格里村，当地陶烟斗生产也因此中断。

en.s: The Dunedin North by-election of 1922 was a by-election held during the 20th New Zealand Parliament in the Dunedin electorate of Dunedin North. This election for the New Zealand Labour Party was significant as, excluding in 1925, Jim Munro would retain the seat until his death in 1945.

zh.s: 1922年达尼丁北区补选是在新西兰第20届议会期间举行的一场补选，选区为达尼丁市的达尼丁北区。工党候选人吉姆·芒罗赢得该席位；除1925年的选举外，他一直担任该区议员，直到1945年去世。

en.s: The Cristero War (Spanish: La guerra cristera), also known as the Cristero Rebellion or La Cristiada [la kɾisˈtjaða], was a widespread struggle in central and western Mexico from 3 August 1926 to 21 June 1929 in response to the implementation of secularist and anticlerical articles of the 1917 Constitution.

zh.s: 克里斯特罗战争（西班牙语：La guerra cristera）又称克里斯特罗起义或“克里斯蒂亚达”，是墨西哥中部和西部的一场大规模冲突，持续于1926年8月3日至1929年6月21日。冲突是对1917年宪法中世俗化和反教权条款实施的回应。

en.s: 1936 Emperor's Cup Final was the 16th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Imperial Japanese Army Toyama School Ground in Tokyo on June 21, 1936. Keio BRB won the championship.

zh.s: 1936年日本天皇杯决赛是这项赛事的第16届决赛，于1936年6月21日在东京的日本帝国陆军富山学校球场举行。庆应BRB夺得冠军。

en.s: The battle of Anabta occurred on June 21, 1936, when Palestinian Arab militants attacked a convoy of civilian buses escorted by British soldiers in Mandatory Palestine, near Anabta. Two British soldiers were killed, along with 10 or 11 Arabs in what the New York Herald Tribune termed a "major fight" in the 1936–39 Arab revolt in Palestine and The Baltimore Sun described as the "heaviest engagement" of the revolt at that point.

zh.s: 安纳卜塔战役于1936年6月21日爆发，巴勒斯坦阿拉伯武装人员在托管巴勒斯坦的安纳卜塔附近，袭击了一支由英军护送的民用巴士车队。两名英国士兵和10至11名阿拉伯人死亡。《纽约先驱论坛报》称这是一场“重大交火”，《巴尔的摩太阳报》则称这是1936至1939年巴勒斯坦阿拉伯起义截至当时最激烈的交战。

en.t: 1936 Copa del Presidente de la República final
en.s: The 1936 Copa del Presidente de la República final decided the winner of the 1936 Copa del Presidente de la República, the 36th staging of Spain's premier football cup, now known as the Copa del Rey. The final was the last one before the tournament was cancelled due to the Spanish Civil War until 1939, and therefore the last one under the "Copa del Predidente de la República" name.

zh.s: 1936年共和国总统杯决赛决出了1936年该项赛事的冠军。这是西班牙顶级足球杯赛的第36届，后来该赛事更名为国王杯。由于西班牙内战，赛事停办至1939年，因此这是停办前的最后一届决赛，也是最后一次使用“共和国总统杯”这一名称。

en.s: The 1936 Cupa României final was the third final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between Ripensia Timişoara and Unirea Tricolor București, and was won by Ripensia Timişoara after a game with 6 goals. It was the second cup trophy won by the Timișoara team.

zh.s: 1936年罗马尼亚杯决赛是这项罗马尼亚顶级足球杯赛的第三届决赛，由蒂米什瓦拉里彭西亚队对阵布加勒斯特特里科洛尔联盟队。比赛共打进6球，最终由蒂米什瓦拉里彭西亚队获胜。这是这支蒂米什瓦拉球队赢得的第二座杯赛奖杯。

en.s: The West Dorset by-election of 1941 was held on 21 June 1941. The by-election was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Conservative MP, Philip Colfox. It was won by the Conservative candidate Simon Wingfield-Digby.

zh.s: 1941年西多塞特选区补选于1941年6月21日举行，原因是现任保守党议员菲利普·科尔福克斯辞职。保守党候选人西蒙·温菲尔德-迪格比胜出。

en.s: The Battle of Damascus (18–21 June 1941) was the final action of the Allied advance on Damascus in Syria during the Syria–Lebanon campaign in World War II. The initial advance was undertaken by Indian troops who were tasked with capturing Mezzeh while Free French forces were to capture Qadam. While the Free French were held up, the Indian troops were able to capture Mezzeh and then became cut off following a Vichy French counterattack.

zh.s: 大马士革战役于1941年6月18日至21日进行，是第二次世界大战叙利亚—黎巴嫩战役期间盟军向大马士革推进的最后一场战斗。印度部队最初奉命攻占梅泽，法国自由军则负责攻占卡达姆。法国自由军遭阻击时，印度部队成功占领梅泽，但随后因维希法国军队反攻而陷入孤立。

en.s: The Copa del Generalísimo 1942 final was the 40th final of the King's Cup. The final was played at Estadio Chamartín in madrid, on 21 June 1942, being won by Barcelona, who beat Athletic Bilbao 4–3 after extra time.

zh.s: 1942年总司令杯决赛是国王杯的第40场决赛，于1942年6月21日在马德里的查马丁球场举行。巴塞罗那在加时赛后以4比3击败毕尔巴鄂竞技，夺得冠军。

en.s: The Bombardment of Fort Stevens occurred in June 1942, in the American Theater and the Pacific Theater of World War II. The Imperial Japanese submarine I-25 fired on Fort Stevens, which defended the Oregon side of the Columbia River's Pacific entrance.

zh.s: 史蒂文斯堡炮击发生于1942年6月，是第二次世界大战美国战区和太平洋战区的一次袭击。日本帝国海军I-25号潜艇向史蒂文斯堡开火。该堡垒负责防守俄勒冈州一侧的哥伦比亚河太平洋入海口。

en.s: The Battle of Gazala, also the Gazala Offensive (Italian: Battaglia di Ain el-Gazala; German: Schlacht von Gazala), was fought near the village of Gazala during the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War, west of the port of Tobruk in Libya, from 26 May to 21 June 1942.

zh.s: 加扎拉战役又称加扎拉攻势，于1942年5月26日至6月21日在利比亚托布鲁克以西的加扎拉村附近爆发，属于第二次世界大战西部沙漠战役。

en.s: The Axis capture of Tobruk, also known as the Fall of Tobruk and the Second Battle of Tobruk (17–21 June 1942) was part of the Western Desert campaign in Libya during the Second World War. The battle was fought by the Panzerarmee Afrika (Armata Corazzata Africa in Italian), a German–Italian military force in North Africa which included the Afrika Korps (Generalleutnant Erwin Rommel), against the British Eighth Army (General Neil Ritchie) which comprised contingents from Britain, India, South Africa and other Allied nations.

en.s: The Battle of Okinawa (Japanese: 沖縄戦, Hepburn: Okinawa-sen), codenamed Operation Iceberg, was a major battle of the Pacific War fought on the island of Okinawa by the United States Army and United States Marine Corps forces against the Imperial Japanese Army. The initial invasion of Okinawa on 1 April 1945 was the largest amphibious assault in the Pacific Theater of World War II.
en.n: World War II: The Battle of Okinawa ends when the organized resistance of Imperial Japanese Army forces collapses in the Mabuni area on the southern tip of the main island.

en.t: The Primer Congreso del Hombre Andino is inaugurated in Arica, Chile
en.s: Primer Congreso del Hombre Andino (First Conference of the Andean Man) was an academic conference in northern Chile organized by the northern branch of the University of Chile in June 1973. Its subject was the Indigenous societies of the Andean world, be these modern, historical or archaeological. The conference was an important milestone in the development of Andean studies including Andean archaeology and for Chile it marked the maturation of academic studies carried out by scholars based in its northern cities.

zh.t: 首届安第斯人类学大会在智利阿里卡开幕
zh.s: 首届安第斯人类学大会是一次学术会议，由智利大学北部分校于1973年6月在智利北部举办。会议主题是安第斯地区的原住民社会，包括现代社会、历史社会和考古研究。大会推动了安第斯研究（包括安第斯考古学）的发展，也标志着智利北部城市的学者所开展的学术研究逐渐成熟。

en.t: U.S. Supreme Court issues Miller v. California obscenity ruling
en.s: On June 21, 1973, the U.S. Supreme Court issued its decision in Miller v. California. The ruling set out a three-part test for deciding when sexually explicit material is legally obscene and may fall outside First Amendment protection. Courts must consider community standards, whether the work depicts legally defined sexual conduct in a patently offensive way, and whether the work as a whole has serious literary, artistic, political or scientific value.
en.n: June 21 is the Supreme Court's decision date, not the date the case was argued.

zh.t: 美国最高法院就“米勒诉加利福尼亚州案”作出判决
zh.s: 1973年6月21日，美国最高法院就“米勒诉加利福尼亚州案”作出判决，提出判断露骨性内容是否属于法律上淫秽物的三项标准。法院需看一般人依当地社会标准如何判断，内容是否以明显冒犯的方式描绘法律所界定的性行为，以及作品整体是否具有严肃的文学、艺术、政治或科学价值。
zh.n: 6月21日是最高法院公布判决的日期，不是开庭辩论的日期。

en.s: Córdoba 1978 (known in Austria as Das Wunder von Córdoba (The Miracle of Córdoba) and in Germany as Die Schmach von Córdoba or Die Schande von Córdoba (The Disgrace of Córdoba)), describes the game of football between defending World Champions West Germany and Austria that occurred on 21 June 1978 at the conclusion of the second round of the 1978 FIFA World Cup, in Córdoba, Argentina. en.s: French legislative elections took place on 14 June and 21 June 1981 to elect the seventh National Assembly of the Fifth Republic. On 10 May 1981 François Mitterrand was elected President of France. He became the first Socialist to win this post under universal suffrage. It was also the first occasion of alternance (between the right and the left) in government during the Fifth Republic. The new head of state nominated Pierre Mauroy to lead a Socialist cabinet. Then, he dissolved the National Assembly so that he could rely on a parliamentary majority.

en.t: 2004 Iranian seizure of Royal Navy personnel

en.t: 2025 Santa Catarina hot air balloon crash
en.s: On 21 June 2025, a hot air balloon caught fire and crashed in Praia Grande, Santa Catarina, Brazil, killing 8 of the 21 people on board. It is the deadliest ballooning accident in Brazil and the deadliest worldwide since 2016, when 16 people were killed in a collision between a hot air balloon and power lines near Lockhart, Texas, United States.
